user.title: Set up Hydropmeter
user.description:
Connect your Hydrop Systems water meter to Home Assistant.

All credentials can be found in the Hydrop app. The connection will be tested automatically after confirming -- the integration is only saved if successful.

Integration by DanielWeeber

data_description.name: What should the sensor be called in Home Assistant? E.g. 'Water Meter Basement'.
data_description.sensor_name: Exact name of the sensor as shown in the Hydrop app, e.g. 'Wasserzaehler'. Case-sensitive.
data_description.api_key: Your personal API key. Found in the Hydrop app under 'Settings'. Do not share.
data_description.entity_unique_id: Technical ID in Home Assistant. Leave default -- only change if you have multiple Hydropmeter devices.
data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) the meter reading is fetched. Minimum: 60. Recommended: 300 (every 5 minutes).
data_description.enable_flow_sensor: Enabled: The integration automatically creates a second sensor 'Flow rate (m³/h)'. The value appears after the second polling cycle. Disabled: Create a flow sensor manually via Settings -> Helpers -> Derivative (source: this water meter, time unit: hours).

error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key. Please check that you copied the correct key from the Hydrop app.
error.sensor_not_found: Sensor not found. Please check the sensor identifier exactly -- it is case-sensitive.
error.no_sensor_data: Connection succeeded but no sensor data was returned. Please check the sensor identifier.
error.no_records: Sensor found but no readings available yet. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.network_error: Cannot reach the Hydrop API. Please check that Home Assistant has internet access.
error.timeout: The Hydrop API did not respond (timeout). Please try again in a moment.
error.server_error: The Hydrop server reported an error. Please try again later.
error.invalid_response: The API returned an unreadable response. Please check the sensor identifier and API key.
error.cannot_connect: Connection to the Hydrop API failed. Please check all inputs and ensure Home Assistant has internet access.
error.unknown: Unknown error. Please check Settings -> System -> Logs and search for 'hydropmeter'.
